scope: Heaptrack records the full process. Attribution accepts only allocation backtraces containing doc_retention_probe_0917::measure_one, which encloses the one measured public lifecycle; preparation, reference routes and post-sample oracles are excluded by this stack predicate. Verify this predicate from retained stacks before making scoped claims.
metrics: Allocation call-stack counts and, only if independently decoded and reconciled, requested bytes. Heaptrack process peaks and merged backtrace peaks are not lifecycle peak-live evidence. No latency, native-cycle or hardware-cache claim.
correctness: Each raw probe report must pass unchanged change-0917 capture.validate_report with zero warmups and one sample, all twenty gates. Fixture identities and binary hash are checked before capture. Repetitions must preserve exact output/control identities.
custody: Exclusive child directories; preserve failed attempts; raw heaptrack and large analysis stay external. Small summaries bind filename, size, SHA-256 and exact regeneration commands. No production candidate or adoption gate is authorized by this attribution protocol.
